location_lifecycle.label: Facility Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a processing plant or drop-off point. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The processing plant or drop-off point is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The processing plant or drop-off point is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The processing plant or drop-off point is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the processing plant or drop-off point are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the processing plant or drop-off point.
